A03.decision: Dirty compares memory with last-saved content, not current disk

A04.decision: Preset definition remains language/framework run/debug configuration

A05.decision: redb remains selected durable settings/session/project/editor store

A06.decision: seglog remains canonical append-only ledger; editor analytics events optional

A07.decision: FileSafe remains agent patch/apply/verify guards, adjacent owner

A09.decision: Read-only/write-lock/active recovery replay constrain user and preview mutation

A10.decision: Agent/FileSafe/LSP paths record operation class and do not merge user undo

A11.decision: Restore/recovery confirmation/context, applied-version authority and undo explanation

A12.decision: One dirty/saved version/save-retry authority across panes and mutation flows

A13.decision: Typing/paste/delete, preview patches, LSP/FileSafe, restore, disk resolution, agent stream source classes

A15.decision: Undo/restore/git histories remain distinct; runtime safe points are not restore points

A16.decision: In-place single-buffer preview/LSP group eligibility; multi-file/rename/hunk/repo/conflict broader flow

A17.decision: Assistant one-file undo group; multi-file receipt and one undo/file; no global Ctrl+Z

A18.decision: Stage/unstage/discard are git; conflict choices edit result until resolve/stage

A19.decision: Tree/targets, previews and diff share source authority; SSH changes capabilities, not buffer model

A22.decision: Named adjacent owner contracts/owner hints are dependencies; absence not a whole-project defect

A24.decision: Explicit Save and visible success feedback; no auto-save

A25.decision: Failure retains buffer/dirty/prior saved state; disk/permission/path/read-only/remote reason and Retry/Save As

A26.decision: Per-tab dirty indicator plus other stable shell location under crowded strip

A27.decision: Chat/tree/quick-open OpenFile callers converge on common open path

A28.decision: Backend recovery/history refresh via BufferReverted events

A29.decision: Disk Revert distinct from chat-owned cmd.chat.revert; editor never fabricates restore

A30.decision: Omitted target_message_id selects latest mutating assistant turn; full-turn multi-file restore and refresh

A31.decision: Restore to/History fetch backend restore points; editor/document pane use same pipeline and create none

A32.decision: Required MVP recovery for local and remote-backed buffers

A33.decision: Remote recovery is local unsaved memory; exact banner, never remote write receipt

A34.decision: Reconnect or destination revalidation before remote Save/flush success

A35.decision: Remote editing MVP does not imply remote terminal/run-debug availability

A36.decision: Exact Work offline (cached files only); validated cached snapshot; old label compatibility only

A37.decision: No cache means disabled/no-cached-files state; no full-project offline implication

A38.decision: Connected/reconnecting/unavailable/pending/read-only states; retain buffers; block unconfirmed round-trips unless queued

A39.decision: Disconnected listings/search/diff/git/shell/LSP/write unavailable or pending, never fake-live

A40.decision: Dirty disk-Revert confirmation Discard/Cancel; reload clears dirty

A41.decision: Save before overwrite and editor/window/tab focus checks; not every keystroke

A42.decision: Single combined dirty+changed prompt Reload/Overwrite/Cancel and Show diff; no two dialogs

A43.decision: Per-buffer undo/redo; Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y; no cross-file undo

A44.decision: Copy/Cut/Paste keyboard/context menu/system clipboard; optional paste normalization

A45.decision: Code wrap off by default, optional toggle; monospace/theme or editor font settings

A46.decision: UTF-8 editable; invalid decode read-only with reason until external repair/revert

A47.decision: Preserve CRLF/LF/CR; explicit Save only; no auto-save

A48.decision: Binary read-only with clear reason; no hex view MVP

A50.decision: Configurable 10,000-line default, settings editor labels/ranges and redb persistence

A53.decision: Above cap File too large to edit, View read-only (truncated), Open in system editor
